description.en: Whole map area (Palaestina I–III, Arabia, Phoenice, Egypt).
description.ar: كامل منطقة الخريطة (فلسطين الأولى والثانية والثالثة، العربية، فينيقية، مصر).
description.he: כל שטח המפה (פלשתינה הראשונה, השנייה והשלישית, ארביה, פיניקה, מצרים).

sources.quote: the country enjoyed peace and prosperity until 611, when Khosrow II, king of Persia, launched an invasion of Byzantine territory
In January of 395, Theodosius the Great died and his two sons took theoretical control of the two halves of the Roman Empire.
The beginning of the struggle of the Persians with the Christians of Jerusalem was on the 15th April, in the second indiction, in the fourth year of the Emperor Heraclius.

description.en: Restored after the Persian withdrawal; then the Arab invasions (from 634).
description.ar: استُعيدت بعد الانسحاب الفارسي؛ ثم الغزوات العربية (من 634).
description.he: הושבה לאחר הנסיגה הפרסית; ואז הפלישות הערביות (מ-634).

sources.quote: In 628 the Byzantine emperor Heraclius recovered Palestine
All Ḵosrow’s wartime gains had to be relinquished before a final peace treaty was eventually signed in 630.
is devoted to the period of 628-633, i.e. to Byzantium after the victory over Persia on the eve of the Arab invasion
Ancak savaş müslümanların kesin zaferiyle sonuçlandı (28 Cemâziyelevvel 13 / 30 Temmuz 634).
12 Receb 15 (20 Ağustos 636) tarihinde cereyan eden savaşta Bizans ordusu ağır bir yenilgiye uğradı

description.en: Only Jerusalem (to 638) and Caesarea (to October 640) held out after the Yarmuk.
description.ar: القدس وحدها (حتى 638) وقيسارية (حتى تشرين الأول/أكتوبر 640) صمدتا بعد اليرموك.
description.he: רק ירושלים (עד 638) וקיסריה (עד אוקטובר 640) החזיקו מעמד לאחר הירמוך.

sources.quote: Only Jerusalem and Caesarea held out, the former until 638, when it surrendered to the Muslims, and the latter until October 640.
Halife Ömer 17 (638) yılında bizzat gelerek şehri Patrik Sophronios’tan teslim aldı
Daha sonra da Askalân ile (19/640) Kaysâriye (20 yılı başları / 640 sonu) başta olmak üzere diğer şehirler ele geçirildi.
Its conquest took place in Shauwal, year 19.

sources.locator: ch. XII "The Conquest of Syria", p. 153 of the scanned printing
sources.quote: In the south only Jerusalem and Caesarea, which was strictly Hellenized, held their gates stubbornly closed in the face of the invaders, the former till 638 and the latter till October 640.
The conquest of Jerusalem took place in the year 17.
Kaisariyah was taken by storm in the year 19.
According to still other reports, the city was reduced in the early part of the year 20.
